listed_quote.quote: The Boards of Trustees of Nuveen Select Tax-Free Income Portfolio (NYSE: NXP), Nuveen Select Tax-Free Income Portfolio 2 (NYSE: NXQ), and Nuveen Select Tax-Free Income Portfolio 3 (NYSE: NXR) have approved a proposal to reorganize the funds.

announcement.quote: The proposed reorganization, if approved by shareholders, would combine NXQ and NXR into NXP.

deals.notes: Meeting of 2021-09-22 adjourned to 2021-10-29 (425 filed 2021-09-22). No excerpt states the result of the vote or whether the reorganization closed. The 2022-02 8-K and 2022-06 DEF 14A excerpts do not mention it. The 2021-09-22 notices speak of 'an important proposal' (singular); the excerpts do not say whether a target dropped out.
